# §0 · #2 — Vikalpa and Saṃkalpa

<!-- reader-navigation -->
Movement 09 of 48 · [This room](../ROOM-01-differentiating-mind.md) · [← Previous](08-s0-p1-inner-instrument.md) · [Next →](10-s0-p3-apoha.md)
<!-- /reader-navigation -->


## Proposition — a field becomes a possible course

Mind constructs a context-world through a pulse. [Vikalpa](../../arguments/concepts/C17-Vikalpa-Samkalpa.md) differentiates and qualifies what is available; saṃkalpa gathers selected differences into an intention, commitment or workable arrangement. The formative root `√kḷp` concerns ordering, fitting, preparing and forming. The pair gives that activity two directions: forming alternatives and gathering a course from them. A selection makes something possible while changing what can follow it.

The circumstance is active before every condition has been separately named. Memory, language, concern and the available means give the alternatives their character. To distinguish this from that is already to work within a field of relations; to gather an intention is to give some of those relations a direction. The act's consequence can then change the field from which another intention begins.

The preceding [inner-instrument movement](08-s0-p1-inner-instrument.md) differentiates judgment, appropriation and coordination. Their work is constructive: a trace can be retained, recalled, selected and recomposed. In [Dyczkowski's account](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration.md#page-71-continuation), remembrance and imagination have distinct offices even where both draw on retained experience. What has been inherited can become material for another course instead of dictating the repetition of the last one.

## Warrant — the act changes what the next act inherits

Each act inherits a field, differentiates it and contributes a new determination. The [process argument](../../arguments/A14-Computational-Process-Ontology.md) follows the continuing work of that inheritance. Bergson's duration preserves the qualitative presence of the past; Whitehead's achieved actuality enters later becoming as data; Gebser's co-present structures make earlier forms available within a later articulation. The tattvic descent places the finite capacities of differentiation within manifestation. These accounts supply different ways of asking how an achieved form continues to matter after its first occasion.

Construction becomes self-sealing when the product conceals its source and then governs what the source is allowed to say. A derived account can enter a later context with its original and its interpretation distinguishable. It can also take the original's place. Subsequent accounts then confirm a prior paraphrase while the first text becomes harder to recover. The relevant failure is this substitution, not the fact that an earlier result conditions a later act.

[The constructive course and its arrest as script](../../arguments/A07-Vikalpa-Samkalpa-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) therefore belong to one operation. A rule can retain useful stability while its purpose and application remain revisable. The arrest occurs where changed circumstances can reach only another output under the same criterion, even when it is that criterion which the encounter calls into question.

## Boundary — formation, meaning and manifestation

Forming a course and determining a term's meaning have different work to do. Saṃkalpa gathers differences into an intention; [apoha](10-s0-p3-apoha.md) makes the excluded contrast within a meaningful determination explicit. Conditioned-arising accounts concern the conditions through which an event occurs. The Śaiva account of manifestation concerns the power through which a differentiated world appears and becomes available to recognition. The [language history](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/language-symbol-dialogue/DEVELOPMENT-language-symbol-dialogue.md#language-exclusion) retains the historical differences within this comparison.

Their relation becomes productive because a finite determination remains dependent on more than its finished content. Absence of isolated self-subsistence opens onto the density of constitutive relation. That conclusion follows through the comparison: semantic contrast, conditions of occurrence and manifestation each contribute a distinct operation to it. The result is a world whose differentiated forms can disclose the relations through which they became possible.

## A technical event carries the same question forward

Context, retained state, attention, tool use, inference, output and environmental feedback form a history of operations. Changing a retained source or permission can change which next act is available. A generated result may become an input to a further process, so the distinction between result and source has a concrete technical consequence. The inquiry concerns what these means of differentiation actually make possible and how a returned correction reaches them.

Objective Internality names the mediating office within the whole relation of knower, means and known. A model, memory or self-description is available within those means; its inventory grows as more of the process becomes inspectable. The technical comparison asks how a course is formed, how it meets the world and how its consequence changes another course. It proceeds from those operations rather than turning the subject into one more item to find in their inventory.

## Return — the weave can receive another thread

Weaving requires distinction and joining. The crossing gives each thread a place in a formed fabric, while the act of joining changes what another crossing can do. The constructive pulse similarly produces a course whose history remains active in its continuation.

[Name-through-Count](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD-encounter-region-name-count.md#name-through-count) returns the formed name and intention to their circumstance. An obstacle can expose an omitted relation; a source can correct the account made of it; another person can question the description under which they were addressed. The earlier act's consequence remains, but a different next act becomes possible.

The next movement makes the contrast inside the selected term exact: [apoha](10-s0-p3-apoha.md) shows how what was excluded participates in what the determination means. Differentiation has acquired a course; its excluded field now has to be received within that course's account.
